main_text.head: SECT. 2.
main_text.p: שש לשכות היו בעזרה שלש בצפון ושלש בדרום שבצפון לשכת המלח לשכת הפרורה לשכת המריחין לשכת המלח שם היו נוחנין מלח לקרבן לשכת הפרוה שם היו מולחי עורות קדשים ועל גגה היה בית הטבילה לכהן גדול ביום הכפרים לשכת המריחין ששם היו מריחין קרבי הקדשים ומשם מסיבה עולה לגג בית הפרורה ׃

p.i: Sex conclavia erant in {1}atrio, tria à Septentrione; tria ab Austro. Quæ à Septentrione, dicebantur conclave falis, conclave Happarvæ, conclave lavantium. In {2}conclavi falis reponebant sal pro oblationibus: in conclavi {3}Happarvæ, ibi sale condiebant pelles victimarum; atque in ejus tecto erat balneum pro Sacerdote magno in festo expiationis: {4}conclave lavantium erat, ubi lavabant victimarum intestina; atque inde cochlea surgebat in tectum illius Happarvæ.

main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES:
main_text.p: {1} Per עורה[?], si aliud non addatur, vel atrium Israelis, vel utrumq; Israelis & Sacerdotum, vel triplex, Mulierum, Israelis & Sacerdotum intelligunt in hoc libro ut & alibi Talmudici. Itaq; cum quædam conclavia, quorū hic mentio fit, ad Sacerdotes pertineant, quædam vero ad alios quoque; latiori si non latissima significatione de atrio accipi inpræsentiarū arbitror. page.notes: Hebrew column: the verse is set in Hebrew type in short lines; the words were read line by line and several may be misread, especially the second and third lines and the endings of lines 6 to 9. The Hebrew stanza is given as one paragraph, with the line breaks lost. The marker "ב." above the Hebrew column is a column sign. The word מקום after "legebatur" and the word "Per עורה" in note 1 are uncertain and carry [?]. The text ends at "primo po-" because "nitur" is a catchword at the lower right. Printed Latin, Hebrew and Greek are otherwise read as printed, with no reading errors marked. No engravings, stamps or handwriting are visible on this page.
